verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent-observability SaaS with an SDK and CLI, so opting out of the vendor's own telemetry is a fair question. The evidence only covers capturing the customer's own agent traces. It never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the SDK, CLI or dashboard. The 'skip the analytics layer' note concerns routing traces over OpenTelemetry, not disabling vendor usage tracking.
